critical_code_review_comments: shared.insert_doc() correctly uses doc.copy() before insert_one and pops _id from the original — verified via test_create_note_doctor_ok_no_id_leak (response has no _id).

routes/hexa.py send_reminder_now: hexa_outbox.insert_one(outbox_entry.copy()) preserves the dict for the response — same pattern as insert_doc but inlined (intentional per spec). BackgroundTasks _send_and_log correctly flips status to 'sent'/'skipped'/'failed' depending on Twilio outcome. Verified DB row shows 'skipped' in this env (Twilio not configured).

routes/consultation_notes.py: receptionist 403 enforced on all 4 endpoints (POST, GET list, GET by-appointment, PUT). Update returns 404 when note not owned. Update with empty body returns 400. All passing.
routes/scheduler_health.py STALE_THRESHOLDS reasonable; threshold_minutes returned alongside age_minutes for client-side UX. No auth-bypass; requires get_current_user.
server.py: medication_reminders cron registered via run_coroutine_threadsafe — good pattern, no event-loop closed errors observed.
Minor: get_scheduler_runs() relies on in-process dict; if backend ever runs multiple workers, this state won't be shared. Mention for future scale work; OK for single-process supervisor setup.
